remaining_release_blockers: Safety priority 1 HOLD: NCP360SNT1G overvoltage protection is integrated ahead of a TPS2552DBVR-1 latch-off 50-100mA limiter. The TPS2552 recommended-input ceiling is 6.5V and absolute maximum is 7.0V, giving 1.1V from the NCP360 guaranteed 5.9V maximum OVLO threshold to absolute maximum. CAD checks pass, but the NCP360 published 1.5us turn-off limit does not cover the required 1uF output capacitor, so physical qualification remains NOT_RUN. At 6/9/12/20V and 0.1/1/10V/us, measured peaks at both /VBUS_OVP and /VBUS_CHARGER plus measurement uncertainty must remain strictly below 6.5V. Sustained short must latch off at 50-100mA and recover only after USB power-cycle; otherwise redesign is mandatory.
